events.speaker: DELPHINE
events.text: Sit. The cards are mine, so cut them anyway. I would far rather you suspected me now than an hour from now with money on the table and your temper up.

events.speaker: DELPHINE
events.text: Beat me straight and didn't crow about it after. Those two seldom turn up together. Deal again if you like. I wouldn't, in your seat.

events.speaker: DELPHINE
events.text: I've folded better hands than this town. A cot and honest company will do me. I keep what I win and I don't deal for anybody's house but my own.

events.speaker: DELPHINE
events.text: Four cards and I have a man read. You've taken me the better part of a season, and I am not in the habit of staying in a hand that long.
